name: Nessi
notes: Nessi is a personal assistant you text, with no app or account. She handles reminders and daily routines, to-do and grocery lists, notes from voice memos and photos, Gmail and Google Calendar (drafts need approval before sending), and can be added to group chats. Requested via the form (issue #186).
tagline: Life's messy. A personal assistant you can text.

access.regions: United States (privacy policy: 'Nessi is offered to users in the United States')
